description: This file is a command-line interface (CLI) script for a project initializer tool. It handles parsing command-line arguments, creating project configurations, invoking templates to get initialization info, and outputting the configuration or commands needed to set up various types of projects. It also has functionality for retrieving the run command for specific project types.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types (int, float, bool, str).

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments, encapsulating project details such as name, version, description, author, type, output path, and parameters.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object with default or minimal values, mainly for retrieving template information based on project type.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path string into an absolute path by combining it with a base Path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, with absolute paths for init files.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a JSON-formatted string indicating success or failure, along with optional message and template configuration details.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specific project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the logic for the --get-run-command CLI argument, retrieving and displaying the run command for a given project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point parsing arguments, handling project initialization or retrieval of run commands, and managing control flow for the CLI.

ctags.name: output_json
ctags.pattern: /^def output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_pat/
ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
